posts.author: totocut
posts.body: I'm aware that there is a Strategy Battle system for RPG Maker MV, the type of battle system that games like Fire Emblem uses. I am wondering if there is a plugin that adds this style of combat to RPG Maker XP? If not, what steps should I start to take to translate the MV plugin?

posts.author: Zeriab
posts.body:
This type of battle system is called Tactical Battle System (TBS for short)
I remember Gubid making a pretty popular TBS script.
A little nomenclature note:
MV, MZ -> Plugin
XP, VX, VX Ace -> Script
Using
script
when searching for XP systems increases the chances of finding something that will work for you.
